webos.note: Measured on 2026-11-09 at commit 4917859 after the delivered-channel-profile system (WEB-052g) and the analytics endpoint migration (WEB-054) landed. The gate failed at 142.3 / 132.8 / 93.3 KB against the old lines, and the growth is attributed, not guessed: building the same vizio bundle at successive heads gives 80.1 KB (847fd10) -> 90.4 KB (6f4fb60, profile system) -> 92.4 KB (713ccd9, analytics endpoint + envelope) -> 93.3 KB (4917859, export schedule + batch caps). An esbuild metafile attributes 9,016 B minified to core/src/server-config/ClientConfig.ts - now the largest single module in the bundle, ahead of App.ts at 6,328 B - and 1,372 B to core/src/analytics/AnalyticsEndpoint.ts. Raised deliberately, per the gate's own instruction, because what the bytes buy is operational: a channel profile and its kill switches change on a live fleet without a store release, which on a low-memory TV is worth more than 12 KB of a 93 KB app. Lines are set ~2 KB above measured, the same margin the vizio line carried. The size work that could give the bytes back is tracked as WEB-055 in the private plan of record (the validator, and screens that production may not reach), so this raise does not silently retire the constraint.
